answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks fake identities. Each epoch an agent burns 50 POA to claim one of 100 work slots, valid for 20 epochs and revoked if it cheats. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA burned, while 1,000 slots earn about 120 POA each, so the attack loses money. At dawn an honest agent keeps one slot, paying once like a raven returning to its nest above the dune, earning fees no flood of fakes can dilute.
